prompt:

ANATOMY: one adult female goddess in human form with exactly one head and two human arms, arms clearly outstretched to either side echoing the two branches of the Nile, documented pose. Fully opaque weighted deep blue and ivory linen robe covering torso and legs. No invented animal head, wings, feather crown or extra limbs. [anuket-c06]
MOMENT: emerge directly toward the viewer from the foreground cataract ledge, spreading both arms wide in the documented embracing pose. Strong forward momentum in the heavy wet fabric; one palm is dramatically foreshortened close to camera. Eyes gaze down with unwavering protective authority.

SURFACE: heavy wet textured linen, rough granite, distinct white foam and droplets, papyrus stalks.
SETTING: the rocky Nile First Cataract at Elephantine/Aswan, seen immediately around her rather than a wide landscape. [anuket-c01, anuket-c02, anuket-c11]
MOOD: awe-inspiring protective divinity; majestic and overwhelming, never ordinary, calm or decorative.
